survey: The calculator is shown at an angle, floating as a single icon over a yellow background with π symbols; with no surface to rest on, floating is acceptable. Body: a rounded blue slab, evenly thick all round, with soft corners. Solar strip: four cells set into the top right of the face. Display: a grey screen recessed below the strip and centred across the width. Keypad: a 4x4 grid of raised keys, each in its own place on the face with even gaps, laid out 7 8 9 ÷ / 4 5 6 × / 1 2 3 − / 0 . = +, the standard simple-calculator layout. Digit keys are white and operator keys cyan. The rows follow the perspective, nothing overlaps, merges or is duplicated, and every key could be pressed. There is no clear or on key, which is an acceptable simplification.
